                    ### Question
                    The study of the multifunctional severity of COPD is performed with the BODEX and BODE indices, which have some common criteria. Which of the following criteria is exclusively part of one of the two indexes?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Dyspnea assessment (MRC).
opb. Distance traveled (meters).
opc. Body mass index (BMI).
opd. Forced vital capacity (FVC).

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
The BODE index includes dyspnea assessment (MRC), distance traveled (meters), and body mass index (BMI), while the BODEX index includes forced vital capacity (FVC). The FVC is exclusively part of the BODEX index, as it is not included in the BODE index. Therefore, the correct answer is that forced vital capacity (FVC) is the criterion that is exclusively part of the BODEX index.
